import pandas as pd

def main():
    # List all source file paths
    source_files = [
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_25/training_0.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_25/training_1.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_25/training_2.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_25/training_3.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_25/training_4.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_25/training_5.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_25/training_6.csv"
    ]

    # Columns of the target schema in order and their types (for reference)
    target_columns = [
        'Name', 'Rank', 'Team', 'Position', 'Played', 'SnapsPlayed', 'SnapsPerGame',
        'SnapsPlayedPercentage', 'RushSnapPercentage', 'TargetSnapPercentage',
        'TouchSnapPercentage', 'IntendedTouchSnapPercentage', 'FantasyPoints',
        'FantasyPointSnapPercentage'
    ]

    # Read all source CSVs into a list of DataFrames
    dfs = []
    for file in source_files:
        # index_col=0 to ignore the first numerical index column as per Hint 24
        df = pd.read_csv(file, index_col=0)
        dfs.append(df)

    # All source tables have exactly the same schema as the target schema (same columns and types)
    # So we can concatenate (union) all source DataFrames vertically
    combined_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

    # Reorder columns to match target schema exactly (should already match, but to be safe)
    combined_df = combined_df[target_columns]

    # Ensure data types match target schema:
    # According to target schema:
    # Name: string
    combined_df['Name'] = combined_df['Name'].astype(str)
    # Rank: integer
    combined_df['Rank'] = combined_df['Rank'].astype(int)
    # Team: string
    combined_df['Team'] = combined_df['Team'].astype(str)
    # Position: string
    combined_df['Position'] = combined_df['Position'].astype(str)
    # Played: integer
    combined_df['Played'] = combined_df['Played'].astype(int)
    # SnapsPlayed: integer
    combined_df['SnapsPlayed'] = combined_df['SnapsPlayed'].astype(int)
    # SnapsPerGame: float
    combined_df['SnapsPerGame'] = combined_df['SnapsPerGame'].astype(float)
    # SnapsPlayedPercentage: float
    combined_df['SnapsPlayedPercentage'] = combined_df['SnapsPlayedPercentage'].astype(float)
    # RushSnapPercentage: float
    combined_df['RushSnapPercentage'] = combined_df['RushSnapPercentage'].astype(float)
    # TargetSnapPercentage: float
    combined_df['TargetSnapPercentage'] = combined_df['TargetSnapPercentage'].astype(float)
    # TouchSnapPercentage: float
    combined_df['TouchSnapPercentage'] = combined_df['TouchSnapPercentage'].astype(float)
    # IntendedTouchSnapPercentage: float
    combined_df['IntendedTouchSnapPercentage'] = combined_df['IntendedTouchSnapPercentage'].astype(float)
    # FantasyPoints: float
    combined_df['FantasyPoints'] = combined_df['FantasyPoints'].astype(float)
    # FantasyPointSnapPercentage: float
    combined_df['FantasyPointSnapPercentage'] = combined_df['FantasyPointSnapPercentage'].astype(float)

    # Write the combined DataFrame to the target CSV file
    output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_25/target_multisource_cot.csv"
    combined_df.to_csv(output_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
